overview: Evaluation of Acute Chest Pain in Patients with Cocaine and Methamphetamine Use is discussed with reference to the risk of coronary syndromes.
Shared decision-making is emphasized in the management of patients with acute chest pain.
Analysis of electrocardiography in detecting methamphetamine-related cardiac pathology.
Guidelines for managing patients with non-ST-elevation acute coronary syndromes (NSTE-ACS) are described.
Management of patients with suspected acute aortic syndrome includes consensus statements about imaging methods like echocardiography and computed tomography.
